SPRING Stainless Steel Water Mug with PP inside 400ML

Smooth and premium matte texture for a sleek, minimalist look

Bring style, safety, and practicality together with the SPRING Stainless Steel Water Mug. Designed for modern lifestyles, this mug combines a robust stainless steel exterior with a food-grade polypropylene (PP) inner lining to give you a premium drinking experience every time.

With a 400 ml capacity, it’s perfectly sized for your daily hydration needs—whether it’s water at your desk, tea on a rainy afternoon, or chilled juice on a sunny day. The stainless steel body resists rust and everyday wear, while the PP inner lining is non-reactive, keeping drinks free from metallic aftertaste and ensuring hygienic use.

Lightweight yet sturdy, the SPRING mug is easy to carry and comfortable to hold. Its simple, contemporary look blends effortlessly with home, office, or outdoor settings, making it as versatile as it is durable. By switching to this reusable mug, you also reduce your reliance on single-use plastics—an eco-friendly step without sacrificing convenience or style.

Enjoy your drinks in style with the SPRING Stainless Steel Water Mug, designed for everyday convenience and durability. Made from premium stainless steel, this 400 ml mug is strong, rust-resistant, and perfect for hot or cold beverages. Its food-grade polypropylene (PP) inner lining ensures a safe, hygienic, and neutral taste experience with every sip.

Compact yet spacious, the 400 ml capacity makes it ideal for water, coffee, tea, or juices whether you’re at home, in the office, or on the go. Its simple yet elegant design complements any setting and makes it an excellent choice for gifting as well.
